statement.summary: Lemma 3.4 is frozen as one set identity `completenessStatement`: {s | IsShiftSymmetric s} = ⋃_{p ∈ primeFactors n} ⋃_{C ∈ 𝓛_p} Fix(C), with 𝓛_p = `orderPCyc n d p` (the same definition as in Lemma 3.3). The union over 𝓛 = ⋃_{p∣n} 𝓛_p is flattened into a double union indexed by the prime p and C ∈ 𝓛_p.
deltas: S_{n^d} (Definition 2.3, ⋃_{v≠0} S_{n^d}(v)) = `{s | IsShiftSymmetric s}`, with `IsShiftSymmetric s := ∃ v ≠ 0, shift v s = s` (literally that union).
'p ∣ n' ranges over primes (the §3 convention); `n.primeFactors` = {p | p prime, p ∣ n} for n ≠ 0.
𝓛_p = `orderPCyc n d p` (C = ⟨g⟩ for some g, and |C| = p); Fix(C) = `fixedBy (Fin σ) C`.
⋃_{C∈𝓛} with 𝓛 = ⋃_p 𝓛_p is written as the iterated union ⋃_p ⋃_{C∈𝓛_p} (same set).
Set identity, not a counting statement: standing hypothesis σ ≥ 2 kept (the identity holds for every alphabet); alphabet Σ = `Fin σ`.
